relations.quote: The bit network is a binary instance of [linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md), since its wires carry scalars of $\mathbb{F}_2$, the field with two elements in which addition is exclusive or and multiplication is AND.

relations.predicate: performs the chunk interchanges that implement
relations.quote: The bit network performs the chunk interchanges that implement a [binary change of basis](binary-change-of-basis.md) on tape.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: An element of $T$, a three-element subset of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, and let $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$ denote elements of $T$, which we call triples.

symbols.name: source bank
symbols.meaning: The bank of source bits, holding one bit $W_\sigma$ for each triple $\sigma$.
symbols.quote: The source bank $W$ holds one bit $W_\sigma$ for each triple $\sigma$, and the target bank $Y$ holds one bit $Y_\sigma$ for each triple $\sigma$.

symbols.name: target bank
symbols.meaning: The bank of target bits, holding one bit $Y_\sigma$ for each triple $\sigma$.
symbols.quote: The source bank $W$ holds one bit $W_\sigma$ for each triple $\sigma$, and the target bank $Y$ holds one bit $Y_\sigma$ for each triple $\sigma$.

symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire of the ordered neighbouring pair $(\sigma,\sigma')$.
symbols.quote: For each ordered neighbouring pair $(\sigma,\sigma')$ there is a side wire $\zeta_{\sigma\sigma'}$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire attached to the element $\upsilon$ of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For each element $\upsilon$ of $[h]$ there is a central wire $J_\upsilon$.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set $[h]$, indexing a central wire.
symbols.quote: For each element $\upsilon$ of $[h]$ there is a central wire $J_\upsilon$.
